question: Does the HaDukeNN structure component beat or match a tuned modern plain Transformer at equal training bytes, same tokenizer, same data, same backbone, and does it change the scaling exponent?

tokenizer.name: fwedu-bpe32k
tokenizer.rationale: struct32k vs bpe32k tie (FineWeb-Edu p=0.82); hnt40k per-byte penalty grows with size (S-1x 0.0346, M-1x 0.0511); plain BPE removes tokenizer confound
tokenizer.cache_dir_for_both_arms: fwedu-bpe32k-s (hard links to fwedu-bpe32k tokens + struct cache)

data.metric: test bpb_corpus on identical test bytes

shared_args.data_root: <redacted: an explicit local data drive, never the default>

H.r2_inclusion_rule: no r2 arm had a recorded PASS under its own frozen prereg at freeze time; none included
H.members: identity (members(u)={u}, v_base=32768); pre-registered choice, mergeparents is secondary only

lr_sweep.note: XS and S use lr 1e-3 for both arms (T-37 M check: 1e-3 within noise of the best of {5e-4,1e-3,2e-3}); this is a stated limitation. M+ and L cells use their own per-arm sweep pick. Ties (|dBPB|<0.001) go to 1e-3.

primary_rule_headline.PARITY: not PASS AND one-sided 99% upper bound of (BPB_H - BPB_P) < 0.005
primary_rule_headline.precedence: PASS > KILL > PARITY > INCONCLUSIVE; parity_within_margin reported alongside

ladder_rule.multiplicity: Holm-Bonferroni over all rung x data cells, family alpha 0.01
ladder_rule.fit: per arm L(N)=E+A*N^-alpha (4ep) and L(N,D)=E+A*N^-alpha+B*D^-beta; bootstrap over seeds, 2000 reps
ladder_rule.PASS_scaling: 95% bootstrap CI of alpha_H - alpha_P excludes 0 in H's favour
ladder_rule.fit_restriction: drop L from the N-fit iff gain_L < gain_M, gain = BPB_1ep - BPB_4ep (L gains less from 4x data than M, i.e. L is data-limited)
ladder_rule.stage3_stop: skip Stage 3 iff headline verdict is KILL with (BPB_H - BPB_P) > 3 * MDE80(5 seeds)=0.0117 AND the Stage-2 4ep gaps (BPB_H - BPB_P) at XS, S, M+ are not decreasing in N (Spearman rho >= 0 over XS,S,M,M+)

secondary_descriptive: val BPB at matched analytic FLOPs (from eval curves)
val BPB at matched train wall-seconds
lm-eval zero-shot HellaSwag/ARC-e/LAMBADA/PIQA on GPU 1 fp32 (side job)
rare-token decile probe (pre-registered one-sided p<0.01 at headline)
